info.name:
Christmas Evening 
in the Ukrainian Community
info.description: We invite everyone to a Christmas evening celebrating the true meaning of Christmas. Enjoy festive food, coffee and tea, activities and crafts for children, warm fellowship, hygge, singing and prayer.
info.imageDescription:
The angel said to them, 'Do not be afraid. I bring you good news that will cause great joy for all the people. Today in the town of David a Savior has been born to you; he is the Messiah, the Lord.'
Luke 2:10-11
info.advice: Dress festively and bring a joyful mood!

expectationCards.title: The Christmas Story
expectationCards.desc: Remember the birth of Jesus together, listen to the biblical account, pray and sing Christmas songs.

expectationCards.title: Festive Dinner
expectationCards.desc: Gather around the same table to enjoy festive dishes, meet new people and spend time in a warm, friendly atmosphere.

expectationCards.title: Crafts and Entertainment
expectationCards.desc: Create Christmas crafts, play board games and enjoy time together. Activities are available for children and teenagers alike.

infoCards.title: Who is invited?
infoCards.description: Ukrainians of all generations—adults, youth, and children!
